kanzAlMahalliRecord.scope: Simultaneous death or unknown order prevents mutual inheritance; each estate goes to the decedent's other heirs.

khulasaRecord.scope: Survival after the decedent is a condition; the same simultaneous/unknown-order case has no mutual inheritance.

shortParaphrase: A calculator must not silently choose a death order for potential mutual heirs; when order is simultaneous or unknown, they do not inherit from each other.
conditions: The people could inherit from one another and their death order is simultaneous or unknown.
exclusions: Known sequential deaths are not covered by this gate.
blockingAndPriorityInteractions: This safety gate precedes all ordinary and special-case calculations.

sourceAgreement.detail: Both Shafi'i sources state the same survival condition and no-mutual-inheritance result.

unresolvedQuestions: The current single-estate model cannot construct both separate estates and both remaining-heir snapshots.
